usage: giml sync [-h] [--osv] [--central] [--coordinate G:A] [path]

positional arguments:
  path              project directory or pom.xml whose coordinates to sync

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
  --osv             refresh the OSV advisory snapshot
  --central         refresh the Maven Central metadata snapshot
  --coordinate G:A  additional groupId:artifactId to sync (repeatable)
